primary_endpoint: Number of participants with normal transaminases at 24 weeks and absolute change in liver fat from baseline to 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At 24 weeks, 6 participants in each dose group had normal transaminases. Absolute liver-fat changes were −1.9, −7.6, and −0.6 percentage points for 200, 400, and 800 IU/d, respectively; no statistical comparison was reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events affected 1/7 participants with 200 IU/d, 0/7 with 400 IU/d, and 3/8 with 800 IU/d; no deaths were reported.
